evidence.notes: StaticResourceCalloutMock can be constructed and configured in local tests.
StaticResourceCalloutMock responds to Http.send with the configured static resource body.
StaticResourceCalloutMock response headers are visible on the local HttpResponse.
StaticResourceCalloutMock maps one static resource response body.
StaticResourceCalloutMock status text is visible on the local HttpResponse.
StaticResourceCalloutMock status code is visible on the local HttpResponse.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock can be constructed and registered as a local HttpCalloutMock.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock responds to Http.send by choosing the static resource mapped to the request endpoint.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock response headers are visible on the local HttpResponse.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock maps request endpoints to static resource response bodies.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock status text is visible on the local HttpResponse.
MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock status code is visible on the local HttpResponse.

source.content: @isTest private class HttpStaticResourceMockFixtureTest { @isTest static void staticResourceMocksReturnLocalResponses() { StaticResourceCalloutMock mock = new StaticResourceCalloutMock(); mock.setStaticResource('Single_Response'); mock.setStatusCode(203); mock.setStatus('Single Status'); mock.setHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); Test.setMock('HttpCalloutMock', mock); HttpRequest firstReq = new HttpRequest(); firstReq.setEndpoint('https://example.test/single'); firstReq.setMethod('GET'); HttpResponse first = new Http().send(firstReq); System.assertEquals(203, first.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('Single Status', first.getStatus()); System.assertEquals('{"single":true}', first.getBody()); System.assertEquals('application/json', first.getHeader('content-type')); MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock multiMock = new MultiStaticResourceCalloutMock(); multiMock.setStaticResource('https://example.test/a', 'Response_A'); multiMock.setStaticResource('https://example.test/b', 'Response_B'); multiMock.setStatusCode(204); multiMock.setStatus('Multi Status'); multiMock.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/plain'); Test.setMock('HttpCalloutMock', multiMock); HttpRequest reqA = new HttpRequest(); reqA.setEndpoint('https://example.test/a'); reqA.setMethod('GET'); System.assertEquals('A-body', new Http().send(reqA).getBody()); HttpRequest reqB = new HttpRequest(); reqB.setEndpoint('https://example.test/b'); reqB.setMethod('GET'); HttpResponse second = new Http().send(reqB); System.assertEquals(204, second.getStatusCode()); System.assertEquals('Multi Status', second.getStatus()); System.assertEquals('B-body', second.getBody()); System.assertEquals('text/plain', second.getHeader('content-type')); } }
